items.title: Postgres recovery_prefetch can cause outages
items.summary: 📝 I wouldn’t have any issue with that. The read IOPS amplification combined with Postgres design for synchronous replication is what turns recovery_prefetch into an actual outage-inducing killer. It really is this easy to consistently reproduce this outage.🔗 Read more: https://ardentperf.com/2026/10/20/postgres-recovery_prefetch-considered-harmful-and-causing-outages/
